description: SP ENW - DFES - Bulk Supply Point Polygons is a dataset listed in Electricity North West open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Electricity North West. Dataset Classification - Open SP ENW - DFES - BSP Polygons Specifically formatted to align with SP ENW DFES data, this Polygon dataset is still created using Voronoi methodology (described below), but includes the polygonal representation of the sites joined together or split through busbars as defined in SP ENW's DFES submission. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Forecasting Data. Its keywords are Polygon, Voronoi, BSP, Substation, DFESMAP, Battery Storage Persona. The portal shows 2026-06-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-enw-open-data-portal.
